name: pinref

shots.onScreen: "Your" alone, low-left; a phone edge peeks top-right
shots.moves: the word arrives; the phone begins to slide in

shots.onScreen: "Your DeFi Positions"; three phone screens stack in at right
shots.moves: screens slide in from the right and stack with an offset

shots.onScreen: the screen stack fans and rotates; "Monitored" label
shots.moves: the stack fans open in perspective

shots.onScreen: one phone slides to centre and tilts; green ticks on its UI; the field shifts blue to purple
shots.moves: the phone travels to centre and tilts back

shots.onScreen: the phone holds; "Liquidation Risk" panels fan in behind it
shots.moves: 3D card panels arrive from the right and fan

shots.onScreen: "Liquidation Risk" cards tilt and spread; a purple blob
shots.moves: cards tilt and spread wider

shots.onScreen: "Rate Changes" cards fan with a small chart
shots.moves: cards fan; the chart line draws

shots.onScreen: cards spread flat; "Filtered to your positions" (accent on "your positions")
shots.moves: cards spread to a grid; the phrase types

shots.onScreen: "Paste Your Wallet"; a phone with a purple gradient screen slides in
shots.moves: the phone slides in from the right and tilts

shots.onScreen: "and we handle the rest" (orange accent on "the rest"); the phone tilts; an orange blob
shots.moves: the phone tilts away; the phrase arrives word by word

shots.onScreen: a phone with a "DeFi" list; a blue blob
shots.moves: the phone straightens; the list begins

shots.onScreen: the list builds: "DeFi · Tokens"
shots.moves: a row is added to the list

shots.onScreen: "NFTs" is added; the phone content updates
shots.moves: a row is added; the screen content swaps

shots.onScreen: "Perps" is added
shots.moves: a row is added

shots.onScreen: "Prediction Markets" is added; the list is complete
shots.moves: the last row is added

shots.onScreen: status chips scatter: Sub-optimized, Claimable, At risk, Operational, Expired, Out of range
shots.moves: chips fly in and scatter in 3D

shots.onScreen: "Detected & Monitored"; the chips resolve onto the phone
shots.moves: chips converge onto the phone screen

shots.onScreen: "Automatically" (blue accent); the phone holds
shots.moves: the word arrives; the phone drifts

shots.onScreen: "We watch your positions" (red accent on "positions") on an empty field
shots.moves: the sentence arrives word by word; the phone is gone

shots.onScreen: "so you don't have to" (red accent); a brick icon forms
shots.moves: the phrase arrives; bricks assemble

shots.onScreen: the brick icon builds into the "otomato" wordmark
shots.moves: bricks slide into the wordmark letter by letter

shots.onScreen: "DOWNLOAD THE APP NOW"; two phones and store badges assemble
shots.moves: phones slide up; badges fade in

shots.onScreen: the end card holds
shots.moves: nothing; a hold

groundPattern: light → light → light → light → light → light → light → light → light → light → light → light → light → light → light → light → light → light → light → light → light → light → light

grammar.device: a ONER: no hard cut in 45s; every phase change is a slide, a fan, a tilt or a morph
grammar.continuousObject: a phone (shots 2-18, about 32s) that slides, tilts in perspective and changes its screen content; the film is held by it
grammar.field: a light, blurred soft-gradient blob field whose hue shifts per phase (blue, purple, orange, teal); the world turns by hue, never by cutting
grammar.type: short phrases, one at a time, with ONE accent-coloured word per phrase; the type rides the object's motion
grammar.pace: about one state change every 2s; held-state 0-56%, something always moves
grammar.ending: a mark builds itself into the wordmark, then an app end card
grammar.takeForVawe: the JSON panel as the phone; three brand-colour blobs on keyed tracks as the field; one accent word per phrase; the wave draws itself into the wordmark; zero cuts
